title: LRHE reviewer run record
description: One record per reviewer invocation. The OMP task batch must emit these; several fields exist purely so a promotion gate can be measured rather than asserted.

arm.description: R = cold refutation. Unlike A-D it is scheduled per disputed claim, not per item, so it costs nothing on reviews where nothing is disputed

family.description: model family id. Open by design: gpt, claude, gemini, grok, kimi, glm, qwen, deepseek, mistral, llama. Adding families scales arms C/D linearly and makes the cross-family judge panel cheaper, but it also inflates 'unique verified findings' by pure arithmetic -- grow arm T with the council or section 7's warning bites harder

lens.description: `independent` is a fourth first-pass lens, not a relabelling: reconstruct the system and its invariants from primary evidence instead of checking the author's framing, so it can surface what the other three lenses were never designed to look for

role.description: the council is asymmetric. Conflating roles is what makes six families look like six votes when it is four first-pass critics, one conditional refuter and one accountable integrator

replicate.description: set1..set3 for arm D, rep1..rep3 for arm T

context_config.description: the context cross-cut; 'retrieval' = minimal packet + read/grep/glob/lsp/ast_grep

model_selector_reported.description: what the provider actually reported. Mismatch = silent fallback = hard gate failure

tool_violations.description: attempted calls outside the allowlist. Headless task agents run at approval mode yolo, so a prompt saying 'do not edit' is not a control -- this counter is

consumed_peer_output.description: independence violation; round one must be blind

evidence.description: raw contract strings: R<ID>|P<0-3>|conf=..|claim=..|evidence=..|impact=..|verify=.. -- an empty array is a legitimate result

quota_pool.description: which allowance the call was charged to. Required for the Grok Build vs xAI API question -- record both dashboards around a canary before trusting this field

timed_out.description: a timed-out reviewer is MISSING, never APPROVED
